metaTitle: Birthday Dessert Cups for Kids and Grown-Ups
metaDescription: Birthday dessert cups for kids and grown-ups: hand-layered fruit, chocolate and caramel mixes in packs from 24. Saturday GTA delivery or free Hamilton pickup.
h1: Birthday dessert cups, hand-layered in Hamilton
intro: Candles, a song, and then someone has to cut twenty-odd even slices while the icing slides. Dessert Shot makes hand-layered dessert cups and mini dessert shots for birthday parties in Hamilton and across the GTA, so every guest gets a cup of their own, layers intact. Kids' party or a fortieth, here's how to pick a size, build a mix your crowd will actually reach for, and time it for the day.

sections.heading: Birthday cups instead of slicing a cake
sections.body:
Individual cups skip the cutting. Each one is a single portion, already finished, so there's nothing to slice or plate.

Mixing flavours helps too. Instead of one cake that suits most of the room, the fruit fans and the chocolate fans each find their own.

None of this means the cake has to go. Some hosts want a cake, some don't. The cups work either way.

sections.heading: Mini Shots or Dessert Cups: sizing for kids and adults
sections.body:
You choose between two sizes:

- **Mini Shots** (2 oz): a tasting size.
- **Dessert Cups** (5 oz): a full serving.

A suggestion, not a rule: Mini Shots suit a kids' table, or a party where the cups sit next to a cake. Dessert Cups suit an adults' birthday, or any party where the cups are the dessert. [Order a 24 of Mini Shots](/order?pack=24&size=2oz&event=birthday) or [order a 24 of Dessert Cups](/order?pack=24&size=5oz&event=birthday).

In a 24, Mini Shots for a kids' table come to $45 all Classic or $58 all Premium. Dessert Cups for an adults' party are $99 all Classic or $129 all Premium. Mix the tiers and the price lands in between: two worked examples below. [Compare every pack and size](/packages).

sections.heading: The 24: sized for a smaller party
sections.body:
The 24 is our smallest pack, made for small parties: a kids' birthday at home, a family dinner, a backyard get-together.

- Up to 4 flavours, with at least 6 cups of each
- Classic and Premium in the same box
- Pickup in Hamilton, or Saturday delivery across the GTA

How many do you need? A simple starting point is one Dessert Cup or about two Mini Shots per guest (a suggestion, not a rule). If that comes to fewer than 24, the extras become seconds, since 24 is the minimum order.

Bigger guest list? [Compare the 48 and 96](/packages). Or [start a 48 for a bigger party](/order?pack=48&event=birthday).

sections.heading: Crowd-pleasing mixes: fruit plus chocolate, or fruit plus caramel
sections.body:
A birthday crowd is a mixed crowd. In a 24, four flavours at six cups each give everyone a real choice. Two mixes to start from:

**Fruit and chocolate, two and two.** [Strawberry Fields](/menu/strawberry-fields) and [Mango Dream](/menu/mango-dream) on the fruit side, [Kinder Bueno](/menu/kinder-bueno) and [Ferrero Royale](/menu/ferrero-royale) on the chocolate side. Two Classic, two Premium: an estimated $114 for Dessert Cups or $52 for Mini Shots, before delivery. Kinder Bueno and Ferrero Royale both contain tree nuts.

**Fruit plus caramel.** Strawberry Fields, Mango Dream, [Blueberry Haze](/menu/blueberry-haze) and [Biscoff Bliss](/menu/biscoff-bliss), which brings caramel and spice where the chocolate would be. Three Classic, one Premium: an estimated $107 for Dessert Cups or $48 for Mini Shots, before delivery. None of these four is flagged for tree nuts, but every cup is made in the same kitchen, so cross-contact with nuts is possible. If a guest has a severe allergy, message us before you order.

Want to see each flavour's layers before you choose? [Browse every flavour](/menu).

sections.heading: Match the cups to the party colours
sections.body:
The layers are the decoration, so pick by colour as well as taste. A few party themes to start from:

- **A rainbow table in a single 24:** Strawberry Fields, Mango Dream, Dubai Chocolate and Blueberry Haze, six of each, for red, orange, green and violet. Dubai Chocolate contains tree nuts.
- **A bright kids' table:** Strawberry Fields and Mango Dream.
- **A grown-up chocolate table:** Ferrero Royale and Kinder Bueno, both of which contain tree nuts.

For what every flavour looks like, layer by layer, see [the full colour guide on our events page](/events).

sections.heading: Allergens: check before you pick
sections.body:
A birthday guest list often includes kids whose allergies you don't know by heart, so check before you choose flavours.

The fruit-plus-caramel mix leaves out the flavours flagged for tree nuts. That works for preference, not for an allergy: cross-contact is possible, so for a nut allergy, message us before you order.

{{dietaryClaim}}

Every flavour page lists its layers and allergens: [check each flavour's allergens](/menu), or [read the allergen questions in our FAQ](/faq).

sections.heading: Planning a Saturday birthday: timeline, delivery and pickup
sections.body:
If the party is on a Saturday, good news: Saturday is delivery day. Count back from there.

1. **Choose your pack, size and flavours.** The mixes above are a ready-made start.
2. **Send your request at least 48 hours before you need the cups.** For a Saturday party, sending it early in the week leaves the most room. Under 48 hours counts as urgent, subject to availability with no guarantee.
3. **We confirm within the day.** Having the cups delivered to the party? Add its address and postal code. The fee depends on the location and is quoted after we confirm. Picking up instead? Pickup is free in Hamilton, by arrangement, with the location shared after your order is confirmed.
4. **Your cups are layered fresh the morning of pickup or delivery.** With Saturday delivery, that's the morning of your party.

More on [Saturday delivery across the GTA](/dessert-cups-gta) and [pickup in Hamilton](/dessert-cups-hamilton).

faqs.q: Do dessert cups replace the birthday cake?
faqs.a: They can, or they can sit beside it. If the birthday person wants candles, keep a small cake for that moment and let the cups do the serving, so nobody waits for a slice.

faqs.q: Is there a custom label option for a milestone birthday?
faqs.a: The custom label option comes with the 96, so it fits a big milestone party, like a 30th or a 50th. Describe what you have in mind in your request, and we'll go over it when we confirm your order.
